title: Fourier coefficient on a binary affine subspace
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $a,\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ with $\gamma$ perpendicular to $H$ under the standard dot product. The absolute value of the Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ of the indicator of the affine subspace $a+H$ is the reciprocal of $2^{\operatorname{codim}(H)}$, where $\operatorname{codim}(H)$ is the dimension of the perpendicular subspace to $H$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
